definitions.gloss: lingering regret; reluctance to part; something left unresolved in one's heart
definitions.explanation: A feeling of regret about something left undone, or reluctance to leave a place or person. Often used when parting ways or reflecting on missed opportunities.

examples.japanese: {心残|こころのこ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧{心残|こころのこ}りな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}えなかった→会う：00482_au⟧ことだ。
examples.english: My one regret is that I couldn't see my grandfather.

examples.japanese: ⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{色々|いろいろ}→色々：02352_iroiro⟧な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}りたかった→回る：01150_mawaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}り→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ず{心残|こころのこ}りだった。
examples.english: I wanted to visit more places, but I didn't have enough time — it was a lingering regret.

notes:
Describes a gentle, wistful feeling of regret — not sharp guilt, but a sense that something was left unfinished or that one wishes things had gone differently. Often used when leaving a place or at the end of an experience.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心残|こころのこ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a lingering regret
- {心残|こころのこ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no regrets
- {心残|こころのこ}り⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without regret, with no loose ends
- ⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{心残|こころのこ}り: one's only regret

USAGE:
Also used as a na-adjective: {心残|こころのこ}りな{気持|きも}ち (a feeling of lingering regret). The phrase {心残|こころのこ}り⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ is often used positively: to be able to do something without any regrets.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧: regret — stronger, implies wishing one had acted differently
- ⟦{未練|みれん}→未練：04866_miren⟧: lingering attachment — stronger emotional pull, often about relationships
- ⟦{名残|なごり}{惜|お}しい→名残惜しい：10910_nagorioshii⟧: reluctant to part — specifically about parting from a person or place
